findings.problem: Step 4 loads the response but does not pin the columns the query must return; step 7 reads existing.metadata. A narrow select would leave metadata absent. Intent is clear but not pinned to the design's usual precision.
findings.fix: Pin the load: prisma.formResponse.findFirst({ where: { id: responseId, formId: form.id }, select: { id: true, metadata: true, submittedAt: true } }); throw RESPONSE_NOT_FOUND (404) when null. answers come from the request body, not the row.

findings.problem: apps/web/src/lib/upload.ts already exists and exports maybeCompressImage and isImageUrl (consumed by PublicFormPage). The design phrases it as if net-new, risking a scaffold that clobbers existing exports.
findings.fix: Reword to 'extend existing src/lib/upload.ts (currently exports maybeCompressImage, isImageUrl) with uploadToCloudinary(slug, file, onProgress?), reusing maybeCompressImage already in that module and publicPost from src/lib/api.ts.'

findings.problem: isQuestionVisible is currently a nested closure over input.answers inside submitFormResponse (form.service.ts ~1676-1706). Extracting the three gates into validateSubmission(schema, answers) requires moving/parameterizing that closure, which the design does not call out.
findings.fix: Add: 'isQuestionVisible closes over input.answers; move it inside validateSubmission (or give it an explicit answers param) so the helper is self-contained. Operator logic copied verbatim — no behavior change.'
